question: How do you decide what to hand off to an AI assistant vs. write yourself?
rubric_guide:
Strong: articulates a real heuristic (boilerplate/scaffolding to AI; core business logic/security-sensitive code with more manual review; unfamiliar domain as an AI-generated starting draft, not final).
Red flag: "it does everything" or "I barely use it" - both suggest no real judgment being exercised.
